image_bytes_check: The training preflight separately rehashes all exported image bytes before fitting.
visual_review: Eight training examples reviewed. Visible entry stairs, roadside curbs and raised doorsteps agree at overview scale; distant small boxes need caution. The near-duplicate pair shows the same entrance and remains grouped.
limitations: Similarity grouping does not prove geographic, source-session or all-near-duplicate independence.
Source visible-barrier convention may omit unseen descending stairs and is wheelchair-oriented.
Heights and widths remain subjective source attributes, never distance ground truth.
Source boxes are not segmentation masks; no pixel ground truth is created.
Negative images are annotation-defined, not independently reviewed hazard-free scenes.
Research splits are provisional; no trained runtime or warning eligibility is established.
